ValidationRule.description: Prevent an Opportunity from advancing past the Negotiation stage when the Sales Billing Estimate field is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification"), BLANKVALUE(Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c, 0) <= 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Billing Estimate must be completed before advancing beyond the Negotiation stage.
